prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic fine-art 3:4 portrait of an adult European woman with cascading wavy obsidian hair, luminous natural skin, closed eyes, and a serene peaceful expression. She sits gracefully on a vintage floral textile surface with bare feet tucked naturally into the pose and one elegant hand near her collarbone. She wears a tailored black off-shoulder mini dress with delicate translucent tulle layers, ornate ruby-and-white statement earrings, and a black velvet choker. Surround her with muted rose botanical bedding and ornate dark mahogany craftsmanship in a dim sanctuary. Use soft directional chiaroscuro lighting for ethereal facial and tulle glow, controlled shadow, shallow depth, 35mm film character, subtle grain, and realistic skin texture.
